name: Default
shortDescription: Explore and publish SQLite databases through a web interface and JSON API, with faceted browsing and read-only SQL queries.

alerts.message: Datasette starts with no data. Copy your SQLite database files (.db, .sqlite, .sqlite3) into the /data volume and restart the service to publish them. Everything served is public with read-only SQL access unless you add an authentication plugin.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
